item.title: London man charged in fatal Old East Village shooting

item.title: Section of Thames Valley Parkway in Springbank Park to close for repair

item.description: Floriography is the language of flowers and a way to express emotions.

item.title: Pearson: Amid wealth, we've forgotten our responsibilities
item.description: Canada did not become poorer, but we did become less willing to ensure that prosperity had obligations to the broader population.
